items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: And then when it was over here, that thing would be creeping... Clionette make that... And then she come out after that. And then we'd be. We'd break the time... And we'd be on the back of her.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, just an Egyptian piece, Egyptian rag.

Then all at once, you see now this here would be up. And you see it would be halfway there when we're playing. And then when it was over here, that thing would be creeping. Creeping up. Then all at once, the second part. Clionette make that. See, and then it'll hit up there. And then she come out after that. And then we'd be. We'd break the time. We'd break the time. And fast part would bring the thing up in the hurry. Then she'd come out and dancing. And we'd be on the back of her. And she'd be in front of the…
Do you know any other numbers that you played for her, or did you have any other numbers by yourself?
